# Whistler Adventure School

> > Whistler Adventure School offers ACMG-aligned alpine and ski guide certification programs, Cytech bike mechanic training, and outdoor education courses in British Columbia's Coast Mountains.

WAS provides professional outdoor education combining adventure sports with technical certifications including ACMG (Association of Canadian Mountain Guides) mountaineering programs, IFMGA-recognized ski guide training, and Cytech International Bicycle Mechanic certifications. The school is registered with PTIB and offers RESP-eligible programs with T2202 tax receipts.

## Key Topics

- ACMG (Association of Canadian Mountain Guides)
- IFMGA mountain guide certification
- Cytech bike mechanic training
- Alpine guide certification (Levels 1-3)
- Ski guide certification
- Avalanche safety training
- Glacier travel and mountaineering
- Backcountry skiing
- Cytech Technical Levels 1-3
- Shimano Di2 and SRAM AXS systems
- PTIB registration
- RESP-eligible programs
- Kate Kozak (school leadership)
- Coast Mountains training environment

## ACMG Guide Certification Programs

- [Ski Guide Level 3](https://whistleradventureschool.com/course/ski-guide-level-3): ACMG-aligned ski guide certification: avalanche safety & client management
- [Alpine Guide Level 1](https://whistleradventureschool.com/course/alpine-guide-level-1): ACMG Level 1 alpine mountaineering basics: terrain, gear & safe travel
- [Alpine Guide Level 2](https://whistleradventureschool.com/course/alpine-guide-level-2): ACMG Level 2 advanced alpine mountaineering & rescue techniques course

## Cytech Bike Mechanic Training

- [Bike Mechanic Course Cytech Technical Level 3](https://whistleradventureschool.com/course/bike-mechanic-cytech-level-3): Cytech Level 3 advanced bike mechanic certification: Di2, AXS & suspension
- [Trail Mechanic](https://whistleradventureschool.com/course/trail-mechanic): 2-day trailside bike repair course for recreational riders & guides
